description: Two-layer LMFDB routing index. Domains group related tables. Use domain descriptions to identify relevant areas, then select specific tables. Full column detail is in lmfdb_schema.json.

classical_modular_forms.description: Classical holomorphic modular forms on GL(2)/Q: newforms, newspaces, Hecke data, twists, completeness boxes, Gamma_1 spaces, Stark units.

tables.mf_newforms: Galois orbits of newforms; level, weight, char_orbit_label (NOT char_label), char_order, dim, analytic_rank, is_cm, is_rm, fricke_eigenval, traces, level_is_squarefree, level_is_prime, level_is_square, sato_tate_group, projective_image, minimal_twist
tables.mf_newspaces: Newspaces S_k^new(N,chi); level, weight, char_orbit_label (NOT char_label), char_order, dim, num_forms, sturm_bound, mf_dim, cusp_dim, eis_dim, plus_dim, dihedral_dim, level_is_squarefree, level_is_prime
tables.mf_hecke_cc: Hecke eigenvalues at complex embeddings; label, level, weight, hecke_orbit, embedding_m, an_normalized, angles
tables.mf_hecke_nf: Hecke eigenvalues over coefficient number field; label, hecke_orbit_code, an, ap (jsonb), field_poly, maxp
tables.mf_hecke_traces: Hecke traces Tr(a_n); hecke_orbit_code, n, trace_an
tables.mf_hecke_charpolys: Characteristic polynomials of T_p; hecke_orbit_code, p, charpoly_factorization
tables.mf_hecke_lpolys: Local L-polynomials det(1-T_p*X); hecke_orbit_code, p, lpoly
tables.mf_twists_cc: Twists at complex embeddings; source_label, target_label, twisting_char_label, conductor, order (quoted), degree
tables.mf_twists_nf: Twists over coefficient field; source_label, target_label, conductor, order (quoted), self_twist_disc
tables.mf_boxes: Completeness boxes; Nmin, Nmax, kmin, kmax, newform_count, eigenvalues, embeddings
tables.mf_gamma1: Spaces for Gamma_1(N) aggregated over characters; label, level, weight, dim, num_forms, level_is_squarefree
tables.mf_stark: Stark units for weight-1 forms; mf_label, mf_level, stark_minpoly

maass_forms.description: Maass newforms on GL(2): numerical and rigorously certified, with Fourier coefficients.

tables.maass_newforms: Numerical Maass forms; maass_id, level, weight, conrey_index, spectral_parameter, symmetry, fricke_eigenvalue
tables.maass_newforms_coefficients: Coefficients of numerical Maass forms; maass_id, coefficients
tables.maass_rigor: Certified Maass forms; maass_label, level, spectral_parameter, spectral_error, symmetry
tables.maass_rigor_coefficients: Coefficients of certified Maass forms; maass_label, coefficients, coefficient_errors

hilbert_bianchi_siegel.description: Hilbert modular forms over totally real fields, Bianchi modular forms over imaginary quadratic fields, Siegel modular forms of genus 2.

tables.hmf_forms: Hilbert modular forms; label, field_label, level_norm, disc, weight, is_CM, is_base_change
tables.hmf_fields: Base totally real fields for HMFs; label, degree, disc, narrow_class_number
tables.hmf_hecke: HMF Hecke eigenvalues; label, hecke_polynomial, hecke_eigenvalues
tables.bmf_forms: Bianchi modular forms; label, field_label, level_norm, weight, dimension, is_base_change, is_CM
tables.bmf_dims: Bianchi space dimensions; field_label, level_norm, weight, dimension
tables.smf_samples: Siegel modular form samples; label, weight, degree, level, family
tables.smf_dims: Siegel space dimensions; family, weight, degree, level, dim
tables.smf_families: Siegel form families; name, degree, order (quoted)
tables.smf_fc: Siegel Fourier coefficients; owner_id, det, data (jsonb)

other_modular_forms.description: Half-integral weight forms, mod-l modular forms, mod-l Galois representations.

tables.halfmf_forms: Half-integral weight forms; label, level, weight, dim, character
tables.modlmf_forms: Mod-l modular forms; label, level, characteristic, weight_grading, ordinary
tables.modlgal_reps: Mod-l Galois representations; label, dimension, algebraic_group, base_ring_characteristic, conductor, image_label, image_type, is_irreducible, is_surjective, weight, traces

l_functions.description: L-functions and their instances. Use lfunc_search for filtered searches; lfunc_lfunctions for full data; lfunc_instances to join L-functions to source objects.

tables.lfunc_lfunctions: Full L-function data; label, Lhash, degree, conductor, motivic_weight, root_number (text), symmetry_type, order_of_vanishing, primitive, self_dual, algebraic, st_group, positive_zeros, z1, z2, z3, dirichlet_coefficients, a2-a10, A2-A10, gamma_factors
tables.lfunc_search: Search-optimised L-function view; label, degree, conductor, order_of_vanishing, primitive, self_dual, algebraic, rational, symmetry_type, z1, root_angle, is_instance_CMF, is_instance_ECQ, is_instance_Artin, euler2 through euler97
tables.lfunc_instances: Object-to-L-function links; label, Lhash, type (CMF/EC/G2C/NF/DIR/Artin), url — join key between source objects and lfunc_lfunctions

elliptic_curves.description: Elliptic curves over Q and number fields: Mordell-Weil, BSD, local reduction, Galois representations, p-adic data, torsion growth.

tables.ec_curvedata: Elliptic curves over Q; PRIMARY KEY lmfdb_label (e.g. 11.a1); conductor, rank, analytic_rank, torsion (NOT torsion_order), torsion_structure, cm, sha, regulator, squarefree_disc, semistable, szpiro_ratio, abc_quality, nonmax_primes, faltings_height
tables.ec_classdata: Isogeny classes; lmfdb_iso, conductor, class_size, class_deg, isogeny_matrix, aplist
tables.ec_mwbsd: Mordell-Weil and BSD; lmfdb_label, gens, heights, ngens, real_period (numeric), sha_an (numeric), special_value (numeric), tamagawa_product — all three are plain numeric NOT jsonb
tables.ec_localdata: Local reduction at bad primes; lmfdb_label, prime, reduction_type, root_number, kodaira_symbol, tamagawa_number
tables.ec_galrep: Galois representations; lmfdb_label, prime, elladic_image, modell_image, adelic_image
tables.ec_padic: p-adic L-functions; lmfdb_iso, p, unit, val
tables.ec_torsion_growth: Torsion growth over extensions; lmfdb_label, degree, field, torsion
tables.ec_nfcurves: Elliptic curves over number fields; label, field_label, conductor_norm, rank, torsion_order, cm, q_curve, ainvs

genus2_curves.description: Genus-2 curves over Q: Jacobian data, endomorphisms, Galois representations, rational points, local data.

tables.g2c_curves: Genus-2 curves; label, cond (CONDUCTOR IS 'cond' NOT 'conductor'), abs_disc, analytic_rank, mw_rank, torsion_order, end_alg, geom_end_alg, st_group, is_gl2_type, is_simple_base, root_number, bad_primes, regulator, num_rat_pts, two_selmer_rank
tables.g2c_endomorphisms: Endomorphism algebras; label, end_ring, geometric_end_ring, st_label, is_simple_base, is_simple_geom
tables.g2c_ratpts: Rational points; label, known_pts, locally_solvable, mw_rank_proved
tables.g2c_tamagawa: Local data; label, prime, tamagawa_number, reduction_type

abelian_varieties.description: Isogeny classes of abelian varieties over finite fields F_q, with endomorphism algebra data.

tables.av_fq_isog: AV isogeny classes over F_q; label, g (genus), q, p, r, p_rank, polynomial (Weil poly), is_simple, is_geometrically_simple, is_supersingular, jacobian_count, principal_polarization_count, splitting_field
tables.av_fq_endalg_data: Endomorphism algebra data; extension_label, center, galois_group, places, brauer_invariants
tables.av_fq_endalg_factors: Endomorphism algebra factors; base_label, extension_label, extension_degree, multiplicity

number_fields.description: Number fields over Q with Galois groups, class groups, regulators, reflex fields, and extra invariants.

tables.nf_fields: Number fields; label, degree, r2, disc_abs, disc_sign, disc_rad, class_number, narrow_class_number, regulator, galois_label (e.g. 4T3), galt, is_galois, gal_is_abelian, gal_is_cyclic, gal_is_solvable, cm, ramps, num_ram, conductor, monogenic, coeffs
tables.nf_fields_extra: Extra NF data; label, units, zk (integral basis), frobs, dirichlet_group
tables.nf_fields_reflex: Reflex fields of CM fields; nf_label, rf_coeffs, multiplicity, CM_types, galois_orbits

local_fields.description: p-adic local fields and finite fields.

tables.lf_fields: p-adic local fields; label, p (prime), n (degree), e (ramification), f (residue degree), c (discriminant exp), galois_label, slopes, top_slope, is_completion — NOTE: single-letter column names
tables.lf_families: p-adic field families; label, p, n, e, f, c, field_count, packet_count
tables.fq_fields: Finite fields F_q; characteristic, degree, conway (1=Conway poly), polynomial

artin_representations.description: Artin representations rho: Gal(Kbar/Q) -> GL_n(C). CRITICAL: all column names are CamelCase.

tables.artin_reps: Artin representations; Baselabel, Dim (dimension), Conductor (numeric), GaloisLabel, Galn, Galt, Indicator (1=orthogonal,-1=symplectic,0=unitary), Is_Even, BadPrimes, NumBadPrimes, CharacterField — ALL COLUMN NAMES ARE CamelCase
tables.artin_field_data: Splitting field data; Polynomial, TransitiveDegree, Size, ConjClasses, ArtinReps, FrobResolvents, ComplexConjugation — ALL COLUMN NAMES ARE CamelCase

tables.char_dirichlet: Dirichlet characters; label, modulus, conductor, orbit, primitive_orbit, order (RESERVED SQL KEYWORD: always quote as "order"), degree, is_primitive, is_real, is_even, is_minimal

hypergeometric_motives.description: Hypergeometric motive families H(alpha,beta) and their specialisations.

tables.hgm_families: HGM families; label, weight, degree, hodge_vector, gal_label, is_primitive
tables.hgm_motives: HGM specialisations; label, family, t (value), cond (NOT conductor), degree, weight, sign, order_of_vanishing, is_primitive
tables.hgm_monodromy: HGM monodromy groups; label, monodromy_group, zariski_closure
tables.hgm_euler_survey: HGM Euler factors; label, p, t, euler_factor

belyi_maps.description: Belyi maps (dessins d'enfants), their passports, and specialisations.

tables.belyi_galmaps: Belyi maps; label, deg (degree), group, abc, pass_label, is_primitive, field_of_definition
tables.belyi_passports: Belyi passports; pass_label, deg, group, abc, num_orbits, num_maps

modular_curves.description: Modular curves X(H) for subgroups H of GL_2(Z_hat), their models, points, and maps.

tables.modcurve_models: Modular curve models; label, genus, cusps, rational_cusps, num_rat_pts, pointless
tables.modcurve_points: Points on modular curves; curve_label, degree, jinv, isolated, residue_field
tables.modcurve_modelmaps: Maps between modular curve models; domain_label, codomain_label, degree

groups.description: Abstract finite groups, subgroups, conjugacy classes, characters, Sato-Tate groups, GL_2(Z_hat) subgroups.

tables.gps_groups: Abstract finite groups; label, order (RESERVED: quote as "order"), abelian, cyclic, solvable, nilpotent, simple, perfect, derived_length, number_conjugacy_classes, number_subgroups, schur_multiplier, composition_factors
tables.gps_subgroup_data: Subgroup data; label, ambient, subgroup, quotient, index, normal, characteristic, maximal, central, split
tables.gps_conj_classes: Conjugacy classes; label, group, size, order (quoted), centralizer
tables.gps_transitive: Transitive groups as Galois groups; label, n (degree), t, order (quoted), parity, abelian, solvable, primitive, auts, arith_equiv
tables.gps_st: Sato-Tate groups; label, weight, degree, rational, identity_component, component_group, components, trace_moments
tables.gps_gl2zhat: GL_2(Z_hat) subgroups; label, level, index, genus, contains_negative_one, det_index
tables.gps_char: Complex characters; label, group, degree, indicator, kernel, faithful
tables.gps_qchar: Rational characters; label, group, degree, indicator, schur_index
tables.gps_small: Small groups (order <= 2000); label, order (quoted), abelian, cyclic, solvable, gap_id
tables.gps_special_names: Special group names (A5, PSL(2,7), M11 etc.); label, name, tex_name

hecke_algebras.description: Hecke algebras associated to newspaces, their orbits, and l-adic versions.

tables.hecke_algebras: Hecke algebras; label, level, weight, index, structure
tables.hecke_orbits: Hecke algebra orbits; label, hecke_label, dim, charpoly, ell, orbit_label
tables.hecke_ladic: l-adic Hecke algebras; label, hecke_label, ell, level, weight, structure

tables.hgcwa_passports: HGC automorphism passports; label, passport_label, group, genus, signature, group_order, hyperelliptic, cyclic_trigonal
tables.hgcwa_unique_groups: Unique automorphism groups; genus, group (GAP id), gen_vectors, topological, braid

lattices_and_other.description: Integral lattices and cluster pictures for hyperelliptic curves.

tables.lat_lattices: Integral lattices; label, dim, det, level, minimum, kissing, aut (aut group order), class_number, gram, theta_series
tables.cluster_pictures: Cluster pictures at bad primes; label, prime, image, genus, depth, potential_good_reduction
